name: Do trim materials need to acclimate before installation in Denver homes?

mainEntity.name: Do trim materials need to acclimate before installation in Denver homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Denver area homes, trim wood should acclimate to your home's indoor climate for at least 48 to 72 hours before installation. Colorado's arid climate and notable seasonal humidity changes cause natural wood to expand and contract significantly. Installing wood trim straight off the supply truck without acclimatization often leads to open miter joints, cracked caulk, or buckled baseboards as the lumber dries out. Storing the trim inside your conditioned kitchen space allows moisture levels to stabilize, ensuring tight joints and durable finish carpentry that stays intact throughout local dry spells.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, trim should acclimate indoors for 48 to 72 hours to prevent joints from shrinking or separating in Colorado's dry, shifting climate.
